rows.name: A Cold Read!
rows.hint: The best part is getting your shopping home.

rows.name: Arts and Crafts Hour!
rows.hint: Glue, tape, and prayer. The segment ends in two minutes.

rows.name: Bag and Shoes!
rows.hint: Kill Brinejaw in a fight. Never on its own terms: fight it on salt.

rows.name: Bare Knuckle Broadcast!
rows.hint: Sponsors pay extra for no weapons. Allegedly.

rows.name: Batter Up!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the bat. Swing for the fences.

rows.name: Bee Line!
rows.hint: Gate, brood, venom, jelly. Keep moving; they can smell fear and jam.

steps.label: Bottle hive venom in the Drip Works (316)
Take the Royal Jelly in the Inner Comb (317)

rows.name: Big Spender!
rows.hint: The sponsors are very proud of your consumer confidence.

rows.name: Bigger Lunchbox!
rows.hint: Score 25+ in one service. Guaranteed: Second Helping Cooler. Your kitchen chooses the participating claimant.

rows.name: Blooper Marathon!
rows.hint: The outtakes are getting more airtime than the show.

rows.name: Blooper Reel!
rows.hint: Roll credits. Then roll again.

rows.name: Boomstick!
rows.hint: Now kill three things with the shotgun, two in one fight, or a boss.

rows.name: Boss Highlight!
rows.hint: The big ones are worth a replay. Make sure you're in it.

rows.name: Boss Rush!
rows.hint: One boss is dinner. Three is a menu.

rows.name: Brutal Ratings!
rows.hint: Keep the numbers rolling. The viewers love a running total.

rows.name: Carb Loading!
rows.hint: Kill the Garlic Breadwinner in a fight. Hit the bread hard. Harder.

rows.name: Cave Painting!
rows.hint: No words. Big gestures. The audience is older than language.

rows.name: Chainsaw Massacre!
rows.hint: Now kill two things in one fight with the power tool, or hit for 15+.

rows.name: Chef's Kiss!
rows.hint: Score 40+ in one service. Guaranteed: butcher s masquerade. Your kitchen chooses the participating claimant.

rows.name: Clean Up on Aisle Three!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the mop. Then mop.

rows.name: Clutch Performance!
rows.hint: The crowd rose. The crowd sat. The crowd rose again.

rows.name: Cocktail Hour!
rows.hint: Now burn two things down in one fight. Bring more than one bottle.

rows.name: Cold Open!
rows.hint: Rushes, set, loop, flesh, the big one, out. All you, in order.

steps.label: Land the killing blow on the Great White

rows.name: Collect Them All!
rows.hint: Three afflictions, no duplicates. The collectors will be in touch.

rows.name: Comeback Season!
rows.hint: Every season needs a redemption arc. Yours starts in a freezer.

rows.name: Costume Change!
rows.hint: Behind the curtain. Their hands. Four seconds, and you come out as ordered.

rows.name: Critical Casting!
rows.hint: The art department is calling it a masterpiece.

rows.name: Cue the Sad Music!
rows.hint: Everyone falls. Few do it on camera.

rows.name: Dig Your Own!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the spade. Saves a trip later.

rows.name: Do Not Lick the Talent!
rows.hint: The serving suggestion was not a command.

rows.name: Dodge This!
rows.hint: The mobs are embarrassed. The viewers are not.

rows.name: Don't Look in the Oven!
rows.hint: You know how this story goes. So does she.

rows.name: Dressed to Kill!
rows.hint: Wardrobe has a frock with your name on it. You do not pick the hem.

rows.name: Ear to the Wall!
rows.hint: The walls are thin. The kitchen is loud. Somebody is always talking.

rows.name: Effects Reel!
rows.hint: Three new things are happening to you. The audience is thrilled.

rows.name: Equal Opportunity Executioner!
rows.hint: A full menu. Nobody left out.

rows.name: Escargot Express!
rows.hint: Slow. Steady. Upholstered in slime.

rows.name: Extinction Event!
rows.hint: Kill The Alpha in a fight. Clever girl. Not clever enough.

rows.name: Farm to Table!
rows.hint: Know where your food comes from. Ideally, you.

rows.name: Fifty Down, Nobody Asked You To Stop!
rows.hint: The AI has stopped announcing them. It is just a number now.

rows.name: First Blood, Primetime!
rows.hint: The audience wants a body count. Open the scoring.

rows.name: Fizzle!
rows.hint: Sparks. Smoke. A sad little pop. The audience adores it.

rows.name: Fore!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the club. Mind your follow-through.

rows.name: Full Course!
rows.hint: Bring the whole jungle to the table.

rows.name: Full Wardrobe!
rows.hint: Hat, throat, frock, heels. The stylists choose. You hold the pose.

rows.name: Get the Flesh and Get Out!
rows.hint: Some fights you don't win. You leave with the good bit.

rows.name: Ghost In The Machine!
rows.hint: Nobody saw. The cameras did.

rows.name: Gloves First!
rows.hint: Bring teacher something you killed. Wear the gloves.

rows.name: God Save the Queen!
rows.hint: Kill Queen Mellifera in a fight. Sticky is a strategy.

rows.name: Goliath Down!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the slingshot. Ask David how.

rows.name: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner!
rows.hint: When in the Stone Age.

rows.name: Hammer Time!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the hammer. Everything is a nail.

rows.name: Handle With Care!
rows.hint: Deliver the talent without turning it into ingredients.

rows.name: Hands-On Host!
rows.hint: Locks, ropes, levers. Touch everything. Sign the waiver.

rows.name: Hanging By A Thread!
rows.hint: One hit point. The ratings spike.

rows.name: Hansel & Regretel!
rows.hint: Every lesson has a price. Somebody else is paying it.

rows.name: Harpooned!
rows.hint: Now land a boss with the speargun, or kill three things with it.

rows.name: Health Code Violation!
rows.hint: Check it's dead. Then check again.

rows.name: Heavy Hitter!
rows.hint: Swing like the camera is on you. It is.

rows.name: Here's One I Made Earlier!
rows.hint: Impress the instructor before the class has started. Bring your own ingredients.

rows.name: Highlight Reel!
rows.hint: Five crits. The editors are fighting over the footage.

rows.name: Hoist by Her Own Pumpkin!
rows.hint: Kill the Gourd Mother in a fight. Return to sender.

rows.name: Human Piñata!
rows.hint: Something sweet is supposed to fall out.

rows.name: Ice Ice Baby!
rows.hint: Kill the Subzero Bull in a fight. It's leaving. Don't let it.

rows.name: Improv Night!
rows.hint: Make it up as you go. The writers' room is on strike.

rows.name: In a While, Crocodile!
rows.hint: Everyone's easier to deal with once they've had a drink.

rows.name: Industrial Carnage!
rows.hint: The medical examiner has stopped asking questions.

rows.name: Jack of All Trades!
rows.hint: Five skills, five different faces. The casting director is confused.

rows.name: Jammed!
rows.hint: Kill Lady Glacé in a fight. Spread her thin.

rows.name: Jaws!
rows.hint: Kill the Great White Krakaren in a fight. You're going to need a bigger set.

rows.name: Just Desserts!
rows.hint: Kill Sir Wobble in a fight. Stop the wobble.

rows.name: Keep Rolling!
rows.hint: Finish what she started. Try not to be in the next call sheet.

rows.name: Keep the Face!
rows.hint: She'd like to look like herself afterwards.

rows.name: Kill Streak!
rows.hint: One fight. Five mobs. Don't stop for the replay.

rows.name: Knife Skills!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the knife. Mise en place.

rows.name: Leather Daddy!
rows.hint: Now wear the light armour into a fight and take a hit in it.

rows.name: Legendary!
rows.hint: Score 65+ in one service. Guaranteed: teleport. Your kitchen chooses the participating claimant.

rows.name: Live Bait!
rows.hint: Somebody has to stand in the cage.

rows.name: Live Delivery!
rows.hint: Fresh is best. Freshest is still kicking.

rows.name: Long Live the Queen!
rows.hint: Two's a crowd. Let one of them win.

rows.name: Lucky Break!
rows.hint: Some nights the dice are on camera too.

rows.name: Lumberjack!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the axe. Timber.

rows.name: Magic Hour!
rows.hint: The lighting crew has asked you to calm down.

rows.name: Monkey Business!
rows.hint: Hold on to your lunch. If you can't, run.

rows.name: Monster Hunter!
rows.hint: Three trophies for the wall. Different heads, please.

rows.name: Mother Lode!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the pick. Dig deep.

rows.name: Nailed It!
rows.hint: Now kill three things with the nail gun, or land a natural 20 with it.

rows.name: Natural Selection!
rows.hint: Not an attack. Better. The crowd loves a clutch.

rows.name: Neighbours, Not Supper!
rows.hint: Some of the locals are edible. Some of the visitors are too.

rows.name: Not Even a Nemesis!
rows.hint: Get to the Stadium without making one enemy. The AI will be your enemy instead.

rows.name: Not On My Plate!
rows.hint: Never eat the finale. Ask who it's for.

rows.name: Olé!
rows.hint: Stand in front of something harder than you. Then don't.

rows.name: One of a Kind!
rows.hint: Nobody sells it. Somebody knows how.

rows.name: Overkill!
rows.hint: Someone is going to have to clean that up. The AI will notify them.

rows.name: Padded Cell!
rows.hint: That is what the plating is for. Keep wearing it.

rows.name: Pick It Up!
rows.hint: A ruined round is not a ruined service.

rows.name: Pill Popper!
rows.hint: Read the labels. Or don't. Ratings are ratings.

rows.name: Plumbing Emergency!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with it. Hit it like it owes you rent.

rows.name: Point Taken!
rows.hint: Intimidate Madame Sabatier. Every showman has a bigger showman she's scared of.

rows.name: Pointy End First!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the blade. Up close and personal.

rows.name: Pork Belly!
rows.hint: Kill the Truffle Sow in a fight. Find out what she's been rooting for.

rows.name: Power Play!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the stick. Two minutes for roughing.

rows.name: Prop Department!
rows.hint: Every prop on this set is a trap. Use all of them.

rows.name: Pumpkin Spice!
rows.hint: Seasonal. Explosive. Pick it at the right moment.

rows.name: Punching Bag!
rows.hint: Soak it up. The show thanks you for your service.

rows.name: Quiet on Set!
rows.hint: Now strangle something in a fight with the garrote. Nobody hears a thing.

rows.name: Rampage!
rows.hint: The floor manager is calling it a cleaning job.

rows.name: Raptor Rodeo!
rows.hint: They have handles if you're brave. They don't.

rows.name: Robin Hood!
rows.hint: Now kill three things with the bow, or two in one fight.

rows.name: Sashimi Grade!
rows.hint: Freshest cut is the one taken over the tank.

rows.name: Say My Name!
rows.hint: Every move needs a name. Shout it.

rows.name: Scary Monsters!
rows.hint: Make the mob blink first.

rows.name: Scrap Heap Hero!
rows.hint: Now take three hits in one fight wearing the improvised armour. It holds. Mostly.

rows.name: Scrape Your Own Plate!
rows.hint: When nobody washes up, somebody still has to.

rows.name: Sharing Is Caring!
rows.hint: A heartwarming moment. The AI is almost moved.

rows.name: Sharpshooter!
rows.hint: Ten for ten. The odds-makers are sweating.

rows.name: Shield Wall!
rows.hint: Now carry the shield into a fight and take a hit behind it.

rows.name: Showing Off!
rows.hint: The AI loves a crawler who tries things on purpose.

rows.name: Sick Day!
rows.hint: Something is wrong with you. Production approves.

rows.name: Side Effects May Include!
rows.hint: Read the fine print. The AI never does.

rows.name: Signed in Triplicate!
rows.hint: The stacks, the cloche, the contract, Crumb. In that order, all you.
rows.loot: Silver Loot Box, Gold Loot Box

steps.label: Carry it to the Green Room (300)

rows.name: Silver Tongue!
rows.hint: Ask nicely. Then ask someone else nicely.

rows.name: Skewered!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the spear. Pointy end towards the dinner.

rows.name: Slow Food!
rows.hint: Patience is an ingredient.

rows.name: Smoke Break!
rows.hint: Some bosses just need some fresh air.

steps.label: Take the jerky off the rail
Walk out to the Canopy Market (318)

rows.name: Smoke Show!
rows.hint: Kill the Old Cured Hide in a fight. The vents are a suggestion. A good one.
rows.loot: Gold Loot Box, Silver Loot Box

rows.name: Smoke Signals!
rows.hint: Vent, jerky, the big ham, down. In that order, all you.

steps.label: Land the killing blow on Old Cured Hide
Get back to the Canopy Market (318)

rows.name: Smooth Talker!
rows.hint: Charm is a skill. Skills are content.

rows.name: Some Assembly Required!
rows.hint: Craft something here. The monkey makes it look easy. It isn't.

rows.name: Spell Slinger!
rows.hint: The special effects budget has been approved.

rows.name: Staff Only!
rows.hint: It's only one service. Act like it isn't.

rows.name: Sticky Fingers!
rows.hint: Finders keepers. The viewers are not judging. They are scoring.

rows.name: Stock Theft!
rows.hint: Somebody in the freezer is knocking. Politely.

rows.name: Stone Age Engineer!
rows.hint: Every wall, every head on a plaque, every drunk chef has half a recipe.
rows.loot: Gold Loot Box, Silver Loot Box

rows.name: Straight Face!
rows.hint: Lie to Chef Vell and get away with it. He has tasted every lie in the kitchen. Not yours.

rows.name: Studio Audience of One!
rows.hint: Every set has an audience. Some of them aren't finished yet.

rows.name: Talent Recovered!
rows.hint: The show can't go on without its judge. Probably.

rows.name: Ten Down, Ratings Up!
rows.hint: The numbers are climbing. So is the crowd.

rows.name: Ten Takes!
rows.hint: Practice makes perfect. Mostly it makes ratings.

rows.name: Tender Moment!
rows.hint: Presenter touches snout. Music swells.

rows.name: That Aired!
rows.hint: The slow-motion replay is already queued.

rows.name: The Finest Cut!
rows.hint: Take only the part that tasted.

rows.name: The Fix Is In!
rows.hint: You seem unusually well prepared for this surprise.

rows.name: The House Always Loses!
rows.hint: Beat the house. Then beat it again, higher. Then once more.

rows.name: The Other Runner
rows.hint: The one in the wreck will not cross alone, and she will not come home empty-handed.

rows.name: The Show Goes On!
rows.hint: Follow the pipe before the gong.

rows.name: The Show Must Go On!
rows.hint: Score 55+ in one service. Guaranteed: Encore Bell. Your kitchen chooses the participating claimant.

rows.name: The Whole Hog!
rows.hint: The cave, the sow, the heart, home. In that order, all you.

steps.label: Get back to the Green Room (300)

rows.name: Third Time's The Charm!
rows.hint: The AI has started a tally just for you. It is not a nice one.

rows.name: Tough Crowd!
rows.hint: Everyone in the building has had a go.

rows.name: Variety Hour!
rows.hint: Never the same tool twice. The merch department insists.

rows.name: Vault Season!
rows.hint: Locker, token, vault, the Breadwinner, home. All you, in order.
rows.loot: Silver Loot Box, Gold Loot Box

steps.label: Kill the Garlic Breadwinner in the Season Reserve (310)
Bring it back to the Stadium (307)

rows.name: Walking Hazard!
rows.hint: You are now a medical textbook. Please do not touch the cast.

rows.name: Walking Tank!
rows.hint: Now take three hits in one fight in the heavy armour, or survive one at 1 HP.

rows.name: Wardrobe Malfunction!
rows.hint: Some dishes are too good to stay dressed for.

rows.name: Whiff Parade!
rows.hint: Swing. Miss. Smile for the camera.

rows.name: Wizard Weather!
rows.hint: Three spells. Three weather systems. One very confused ceiling.

rows.name: Worth a Shot!
rows.hint: You miss every shot you don't declare. Also most of the ones you do.

rows.name: Yes, Chef!
rows.hint: Score 15+ in one service. Guaranteed: cooking. Your kitchen chooses the participating claimant.

rows.name: You'll Shoot Your Eye Out!
rows.hint: Now kill something in a fight with the BB gun. Yes, really.

rows.name: You've Discovered Fire!
rows.hint: Again. Show your work.
